posts.title: Vätternrundan 2026: A Race Report and the Road Back
posts.description: Five months after a heart setback forced me to restart from zero, I lined up for Vätternrundan 2026 with an FTP of 190W and a CTL of 31. Here’s how the rebuild played out, how PacePartner helped me adapt through travel and disrupted training, and why finishing in 14 hours and 30 minutes felt like a win.

posts.title: June 2026: Training, Health, and Looking Ahead
posts.description: As we move into June, I wanted to sit down and reflect on the last 3 months of my training and health. It’s been a period of finding my footing again, and I want to share where I’m at before looking ahead to what’s next.

posts.title: Training with PacePartner: Planning Vätternrundan 2026 After a Health Setback
posts.description: After heart issues derailed the start of my year, I needed a different way to approach building toward Vätternrundan 2026. Here’s how PacePartner changed the way I think about training when the stakes feel higher and the margin for error feels smaller.
